synopsis: Aozawa Kanata is a first-year university student. Upon entering university, she ends up sharing a room with Ichinose Yui, the daughter of her father’s friend and a third-year student at the same university. However, once they start living together, she learns a shocking truth: Yui is a lesbian, and is known for being a notorious womanizer. This is a university roommate story about a straight junior who is seduced by a beautiful, lesbian senior.

title: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

synonyms: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Evil General in a Hack-and-Slash Game: Destroy the Bad Ending
synopsis: A man works in an exploitative company, and his only joy in life is playing the hack-and-slash game "Brave of Kingdom" when he gets home from work. But one day, when playing the game, he sees something strange, and the next thing he knows, he is inside the world of the game, with the familiar adjutant character Selina before him in her familiar uniform. He has transformed into the game's evil general Zeorg, with his muscular build and full beard, along with his doomed destiny to be mowed down by the game's hero, along with the rest of the game's mooks. Using his survival skills in his exploitative workplace, and his knowledge of the game, Zeorg is determined to avoid a bad ending. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)
